page.content:
Cousteau's converted minesweeper and floating film studio.

How Calypso connects

  • Character: Jacques Cousteau — Cousteau filmed and dived from the Calypso.
  • Character: Jacques Cousteau — Calypso produced the films that made Cousteau's ocean public.

What is Calypso?

RV Calypso was the ship from which Cousteau filmed reefs, wrecks, and the first widely seen color footage of the living sea.

Key threads lead to Jacques Cousteau and Jacques Cousteau.
